scenarios.plan: Bias up but if retail is crowded long, the transcript's preferred 'sell-on-rise / dip-then-recover' path is a dip into 24600 followed by a confirmed reversal.

Ideal for a long setup if Smart Money is bullish. Market likely digs toward support 24600 (may even SWEEP liquidity just below a round figure to grab retail stop-losses), then REVERSES up — that liquidity sweep + institutional level + psychological level is the transcript's preferred long confluence. A sustained close BELOW 24600 with bearish volume flips it to resistance → continuation DOWN.
Trade the band: buy dips into support 24600 (hold → bounce), sell rallies into resistance 25150 (reject → fade). Direction resolves on which wall breaks with follow-through.
Watch resistance 25150. Rejection → fade back toward 24600. A decisive 15-min close ABOVE 25150 (call writers unwinding) → breakout continuation UP toward the next call wall.

next_week.rationale: Positional carry context +0.45 (research lean SIDEWAYS-UP), FII-led with Pro support required.  Big positional moves come only 2-3x a year; otherwise the week trades between the put wall (support) and call wall (resistance) unless a wall breaks decisively. Retail must unwind longs before a sustained up-leg. The carry/trend lean is shown as research context only: its locked five-session candidate did not survive the 2026 confirmation period.
